description:
Make archive preview and `archive candidates` read each target's prior executions from its evidence record through storage, once per target, and delete the archive readers of the event log, including the file backend's second parser.

## Background

Preview and `archive candidates` read the whole event log once per target through `IssueStore::read_artifact_archive_events` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs`; trait default in `storage/mod.rs`; file-backend override in `storage/json.rs`). The override is a second event-log parser with its own torn-prefix rule (`is_torn_event_prefix`) and a raw `"artifact_archive_executed"` literal. Each target's executions are in `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`. Command tests plant prior executions as events and call the reader directly in `commands/archive.rs`, including `test_archive_event_reader_accepts_final_and_multiple_nested_brace_torn_prefixes`; a conformance case in `storage/issue_store_conformance.rs` covers it too. Both integration-test `IssueStore` wrappers implement the trait.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Preview and `archive candidates` read each target's evidence record once through a new `IssueStore` method implemented by both backends and both test wrappers, and read no event-log content.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preview tests plant prior executions as evidence records, and a test shows that preview of a re-archived target succeeds with an unparseable event log and reports the same coverage as before.
- [hard] REQ-03: `read_artifact_archive_events`, `is_torn_event_prefix` and their conformance case no longer exist, and no test calls them.
- [hard] REQ-04: Outside tests of the parser, no code parses the event log except through `domain::parse_known_events`.
title: Archive preview reads the per-target evidence record
